Wiki/Buildcraft/Automatic weapons in pairs

Automatic weapons in pairs

Every one of the 435 pairs you can make at level 4 was run on the same 40 seeds, on both tests. Each card says what the pair put out, how much of that each weapon was responsible for, and whether the two of them together beat the two of them separately. The four longer paths at the top are what a search found in a laboratory, and a laboratory is not a run.

Pairs and paths were run on 40 seeds, not the 40 the single-weapon sweep used. Measured association between each weapon and its exhaustive controlled-fixture pairs. The mechanism is not measured; no causal explanation is asserted. Greedy build selection and reported build performance use the same deterministic seed cohort; there is no holdout cohort, so selection bias is possible. WeaponSystem insertion order can affect cast interleave. Every controlled pair/build uses lexicographic weapon-id order; acquisition-order permutations are not measured. The unlock lines say only whether you could have a weapon, never when it would actually turn up in a run.

How the paths were found

One weapon at a time, best next each time

Controlled simulation only. Pairs are exhaustive over the unlocked base automatic roster; builds are greedy forward selection seeded from the best measured solo on each axis. Each path starts from one weapon alone in the lab and adds whichever weapon measured best next to it. It says nothing about aiming, terrain, moving, when a weapon becomes available, or how a real run goes.
